samples.note: Together stored authorized prompt samples from three serverless models. This is provider-side retention, not a customer-visible inference log by itself.

commit.note: An unnamed coding agent committed a Hugging Face credential to the public repository xorl. Together reverted the commit. The agent product is not published.

download.note: The unauthorized party used the credential to download the samples and then tested secrets found in them, including five Dragos canaries.

notify.note: This stage is Together's investigation, customer notice, and control changes. It is not a further attacker procedure.
